value.rationale: The smallest nonabelian simple group is a canonical and structurally motivated object for exact finite-group Fourier analysis. A complete all-support convolution nullity census identifies nonuniform singularity levels and sharp extremal subgroup-coset geometry. Crucially, A5 needs a five-cycle conjugacy-class refinement beyond pairwise quotient orders or subgroup order, an informative boundary for coarser invariant-based classifications. This is a substantive natural finite classification, rather than an arbitrary partial sample or routine reformulation.
